'''Vertseth''' was a celestial body<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|todo360|Todo 360}}</ref> located in the [[Vertseth system/Legends|Vertseth system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The company [[Vertseth Automata/Legends|Vertseth Automata]] constructed the [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]] [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]]<ref name="TCWCharacterEncyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> at Vertseth.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vertseth was introduced via mention of the company Vertseth Automata in the [[2010]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TCWCharacterEncyclopedia" /> It was later established as a celestial body by the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vertseth [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Vertseth itself, in grid square N-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
